protocol.labeller: the extractor-v0 builder (Claude, an AI agent) for the first pass of every band; the fixer of the same work package (Claude) for the upper, mid and near re-label; one labeller at a time, no second labeller
protocol.before_any_ratio: true of every first-pass label, and so of every summit label here; the upper, mid and near labels of this version were made after a v0 run existed (relabel)
protocol.frames: every Rainier live capture of 19-22 Nov 2026 with the Sun at or above 3 deg in its capture sidecar (NOAA solar position): 105 frames
protocol.views: per frame, a crop of the mountain (x 440-1600, y 230-500 of the 1920x1080 frame) at 0.6x beside the summit dome (x 440-900, y 250-360) at 1x; borderline summits re-checked at 2-3x

bands.summit: the summit dome from the big tree to Gibraltar Rock's top: its skyline and upper surface (first pass, kept: the plate v0.1 summit band is the visible dome above 4,000 m plus a 6 px sky margin, x 477-739, which this matches; Gibraltar Rock's top, 3,863 m, is in the plate's upper band)
bands.upper: the plate v0.1 upper band (world height 3,200-4,000 m: the face below the summit dome with Gibraltar Rock and the upper Nisqually and Cowlitz glaciers, Cathedral Rocks, the top of Little Tahoma; 95% of its pixels lie at x 478-900), judged inside its outline drawn on the frame
bands.mid: the plate v0.1 mid band (2,400-3,200 m: the lower face down to the trees, 89% of its pixels at x 512-900, and the Muir Snowfield ridge with Anvil Rock), judged inside its outline
bands.near: the plate v0.1 near band (below 2,400 m and 1.5-4 km out: the near ridge crest from Panorama Point to McClure Rock, 72% of its pixels at x 1400-1550, the rest x 1292-1700), judged inside its outline

states.visible: the band's terrain edges are distinct (its silhouette against the sky where it has one, and its rock and ice texture); at most a thin wisp over a small part
states.partial: cloud or a veil covers a noticeable part of the band, or makes its features faint, but some of it can still be made out
states.hidden: none of the band's terrain can be made out

protocol.camera_in_cloud: true when the camera itself is in fog: the near trees (under ~300 m) are faded
protocol.clear_day_reference: true when every band is visible and the mountain is in direct sunlight (sky clear or partly clear around it); these frames are extractor v0's reference pool
protocol.sky: clear, partly, hazy, overcast, fog or snow (falling snow in front of the camera)
protocol.light: direct, soft or mixed on the mountain, null when the mountain is hidden

relabel.why: the first pass defined upper, mid and near by landmarks before the plate existed (Little Tahoma in mid, near at x 1240-1540); the extractor scores the plate's world-height masks, so these three bands were labelled again against the masks (review of 23 Nov 2026)
relabel.views: per frame, x 440-1920 by y 250-535 at 0.75x with the plate's four band outlines drawn 1 px wide after scaling, no earlier label shown; ambiguous frames (24) also at 1x: the face (x 440-1010, y 250-540) beside the right ridges (x 1100-1720, y 380-520); the 48 frames whose first pass was hidden in every band were viewed at 0.42x
relabel.after_results: made after extractor v0's first run on plate v0 and its two reviews were read; the per-frame ratios of these bands were not looked at before labelling
relabel.first_pass: each frame's earlier upper, mid and near labels are kept under first_pass
